data.name: vfx_settings

data.description: Bake a Mesh asset into a Signed Distance Field Texture3D asset (programmatic SDF Bake Tool, via the public MeshToSDFBaker). Params: meshPath (source Mesh), outputPath (.asset to create), maxResolution (default 64), center/size ([x,y,z]; default = mesh bounds), signPassCount (default 1), threshold (default 0.5), sdfOffset (default 0), overwrite (default false). Requires compute shader support.
data.name: vfx_bake_sdf
